correctness.rationale: The geometric covering relation is equivalent to a minimax problem over the endpoints of a one-dimensional barycentric fiber. Four triangular sectors give exact affine linear programs; sharp inequalities and explicit witnesses prove both bounds uniformly for all p,q>0,p+q>1. Coordinate-swap symmetry gives remaining sectors, and exact rational LP active-set enumeration passed 101 test cases as supplementary verification.
